Morons Spamming wrote:
> 
>                 MISSOURI HEADS LIST OF ENDANGERED RIVERS
> 
>      WASHINGTON (AP) -- Dams, mining, barge traffic, development and even
>      the changing electricity industry all contributed to rivers being
>      added to an environmental group's annual list of most endangered
>      waterways.

Yep. Pollution sucks, doesn't it? 
Does it make you think the Unabomber is right?
"The Industrial Revolution and its consequences have been a disaster for
the human race." -the Manifesto.

It's true that we are enjoying the short-term fruits of industrialism &
technology. But unless the disease (technology) can find its own cure,
we'll eventually be living in airtight bubbles like on Mars 'cause we'll
have made Earth unliveable.
Do you agree? or are you optimistic?
